title: Modified Gravity Framework for the Woods-Saxon Inflation: Theoretical Foundations and Observational Constraints
summary: We investigate an inflationary scenario within a modified gravity theory that extends the Einstein-Hilbert action through a non-minimal coupling between the inflaton $φ$ and the trace of the energy-momentum tensor $T$. This $f(φ)T$ framework is designed to naturally recover the standard general relativity in the post-inflationary universe. Within this theory, we apply the Woods-Saxon potential.
